texts: Three hours, one shared kit, and a deck you can reuse.
slides.notes: These are your speaker notes. Only you see them, in speaker view; the audience sees just the slides. Replace them with what you want to say. Welcome everyone, cover breaks and timing, and say what they'll leave with.
Point out where the hands-on parts are, so people know when to open their laptops.
Use the section slide to reset attention after a break.
Ask for an example from the room before you show the definition.
Do each step live while people follow along. Check in after step two.
Use the photos to tell a short story about how the team works.
Give people thirty seconds to answer before you reveal it.
Ask each person to pick the takeaway they'll try first.
Share where to find the slides and how to reach you afterwards.
